  "description": "• Manage NPI processes, including prototype/FAI products and pre-production builds in electrical box build, welding, and thermocouple fields.\n• Develop and optimize manufacturing processes, work instructions, process flows, tooling, fixtures, test forms, and production layouts for NPI.\n• Review product designs and provide DFM/DFA (Design for Manufacturing/Assembly) feedback to functional departments or THX stakeholders.\n• Prepare and provide NPI status updates to project stakeholders and coordinate NPI activities from prototype through pilot builds and mass production.\n• Support the creation of fixtures/test equipment to ensure products meet customer drawings.\n• Report to the Assembly Manager.",
  "requirements_text": "Requirements:\n1 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Đại Học trở lên  Tiếng Anh Đọc hiểu\n\nCandidate Requirements\n• Bachelor of Engineering.\n• 1–3 years of experience as an engineer in Industrial, Mechatronics, or Mechanical Engineering.\n• Good communication skills in English.\n• Have experience in NPI processes, including prototype/FAI products and pre-production builds, especially in electrical box build, welding, thermocouples, etc.\n• Good problem analysis and problem-solving skills.\n• Proficient in Mechanical AutoCAD/Inventor/MS Office.\n\nKiến thức ngành\nCông nghệ kỹ thuật, Cơ khí / Tự động hóa\n\nKỹ năng cần có\nProblem-solving, Ms Office, Inventor, Problem Analysis, welding, NPI processes, prototype/FAI products, pre-production builds, electrical box build, thermocouples, Mechanical AutoCAD"
